UDP::unused_port
Description
Returns an unused UDP port for the specified IP tuple.
Syntax
UDP
::
unused_port
<
remote_addr
>
<
remote_port
>
<
local_addr
>
[
<
hint_port
>
]
UDP::unused_port <remote_addr> <remote_port> <local_addr> [<hint_port>]
Returns an unused UDP port for the specified IP tuple, using the
value of <hint_port> as a starting point if it is supplied. If no
appropriate unused local port could be found, 0 is returned.
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
set
port
[
UDP
::
unused_port
[
IP
::
remote_addr
]
[
UDP
::
remote_port
]
[
IP
::
local_addr
]]
UDP
::
respond
"Next unused port: $port"
}
